text:
Devin Park: FYI support flagged that several project-level cost tiles went blank during last rollout. They saw zero on hot routes and opened tickets.
Lina Morales: Can you paste an example route? blank vs zero is confusing to customers.
Devin Park: Route: /api/v1/respgen for Project X. On the heatmap the model_sku cell shows 0 while tokens still appear in other panels.
Arturo Vega: Likely same root cause: ingest zeroes unit_cost for prefetch_replay events and our heatmap query only sums tokens*unit_cost.
Lina Morales: Hiding cost -> bad. We should show amortized or gross with a small annotation. Propose events include amortized_unit_cost and amortization_basis.
Devin Park: +1. Also add credit_reason enum so UI can say whether savings were from a prefetch hit, router fallback, or an explicit credit.
Arturo Vega: Implementation sketch: econ_event v2 fields: route_variant, amortized_unit_cost, amortization_basis ("per-prefetch","session-warmup","global-slab"), credit_reason, sampling_rate, sample_count. Backcompat: effective_cost = COALESCE(amortized_unit_cost, effective_unit_cost, unit_cost).
Lina Morales: UX: default heatmap = "net (amortized)" with a dotted gross overlay. Hover shows tokens, gross_cost, amortized_cost, credits_by_reason, sample_count. If sample_count < 60 show "Estimate may be noisy (N)".
Arturo Vega: SQL prototype: ```SELECT project, model_sku, route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(tokens * COALESCE(amortized_unit_cost, effective_unit_cost, unit_cost)) AS amortized_cost, SUM(tokens * unit_cost) AS gross_cost, AVG(sampling_rate) AS sampling_rate, SUM(sample_count) AS sample_count FROM econ_events WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end GROUP BY project, model_sku, route;```
Devin Park: Ops plan: feature flag `econ_amortize_v1` so dashboards opt-in before full rollout. Need a canary window and raw-event retention extended for reconciliation.
sre-bot: sre-bot: Canary job queued: cost-ingest-v2 -> canary-zone on 2024-08-10T04:00Z (flag: econ_amortize_v1). Retention override applied: econ-raw = 30d.
Lina Morales: Owners: Arturo -> proto + ingest emit logic + migration notes. Devin -> dashboard queries + toggle + hover copy. I'll do the mockups and the low-sample copy.
Arturo Vega: Will open PR today. Note: emit amortization_metadata minimal set (warmup_cost_usd, expected_uses, expected_tokens) so auditors can reproduce amortized_unit_cost.
Devin Park: Also add a "why-zero" link in hover that opens an event inspector filtered by route+variant so teams can inspect sample events. That should reduce support noise.
Lina Morales: Good idea. UX will include tiny link "Inspect sample events" next to the sample_count.
Arturo Vega: One caveat: consumers must compute cost with COALESCE and avoid recomputing sampling_rate via joins; sampling_rate & sample_count must be emitted at source.
Devin Park: Action items recap: Arturo PR + migration guide, Devin dashboard + canary flag wiring, Lina mockups & copy. We'll reconvene after canary to compare net/gross reconciliation.
Lina Morales: Thanks — let's avoid more surprise zeroes :)
Devin Park: :thumbsup:
